title: Lease Loyalty Uplift on the Parking License Storage Bundle Rate
content:
Note to the storage bundle rates of the Parking License: households whose Apartment Home Lease is enrolled in autopay and has a long-standing move-in date receive a lease loyalty uplift on the bundle rate.

## Note

When the lease is enrolled in autopay and its move-in date is at least 1461 days before the handling date, the lease loyalty uplift is 0.03; when the lease is enrolled in autopay and its move-in date is at least 730 but fewer than 1461 days before the handling date, the lease loyalty uplift is 0.02; in every other case there is no lease loyalty uplift. The lease loyalty uplift is added to the bundle rate.

The uplift is in points of the discount rate: 0.03 is 3 points, 0.02 is 2 points.

## Truth table

| Apartment Home Lease enrolled in autopay | Days from move-in date to the handling date | Lease loyalty uplift |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 1461 or more | 0.03 |
| yes | 730 to 1460 | 0.02 |
| yes | fewer than 730 | none |
| no | any | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical leases enrolled in autopay)

Move-in 1461 days before: 0.03; 1460 days: 0.02; 730 days: 0.02; 729 days: none.
